definition_quote.value: Registered nursing means the practice of nursing, which includes: Assessing the health status of individuals and groups; Establishing a nursing diagnosis; Establishing goals to meet identified health care needs; Planning a strategy of medical or health care; Prescribing nursing interventions to implement the strategy of care; Implementing the strategy of care; Delegating nursing interventions that may be performed by others; Maintaining safe and effective nursing care; Evaluating responses to interventions; Teaching the theory and practice of nursing; Managing and supervising the practice of nursing; Collaborating with other health professionals; Addressing patient pain.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered nursing" means the practice of nursing, which includes: (A) Assessing the health status of individuals and groups. (B) Establishing a nursing diagnosis.

value: Planning strategy of medical or health care
Teaching theory and practice of nursing
Prescribing medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures (APRN only)
methods_authorized.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN" means a licensed registered nurse authorized to practice in this State who, because of specialized education and experience, is licensed and authorized to perform acts of medical diagnosis and to prescribe medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures

drug_authority.value: APRNs are authorized to prescribe medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures including prescription medication under administrative rules adopted by the Board; prescribing controlled substances for self or immediate family member is prohibited.
drug_authority.quote: licensed and authorized to perform acts of medical diagnosis and to prescribe medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures under administrative rules adopted by the Board

aprn_role_categories.quote: The program shall prepare nurses to practice advanced nursing in a role as a nurse practitioner, certified nurse midwife, certified nurse anesthetist, or clinical nurse specialist in psychiatric or mental health nursing

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: functioning at the direction of a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, licensed physician, or licensed dentist in the performance of activities delegated by that health care professional

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An APRN with fewer than 24 months and 2,400 hours of licensed active advanced nursing practice in an initial role and population focus or fewer than 12 months and 1,600 hours for any additional role and population focus shall have a formal agreement with a collaborating provider as required by Board rule.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An APRN who satisfies the requirements to engage in solo practice pursuant to subsection (a) of this section shall notify the Board that these requirements have been met.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication nursing assistant" means a licensed nursing assistant who: ... is endorsed by the Board and authorized to administer medication in a nursing home.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Delegating nursing interventions that may be performed by others and that do not conflict with this subchapter.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered nurse (RN) or a licensed practical or vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: Adopt rules establishing a program to serve as an alternative to the disciplinary process for nurses and nursing assistants with chemical dependencies or other professional practice issues as designated by the Board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An APRN may not provide, prescribe, dispense, or furnish medical services or prescription medication via computer or other electronic means without: reasonable effort to verify patient identity; establishment of documented diagnosis through accepted medical practices; and maintenance of a current medical record. An electronic, online, or telephonic evaluation by questionnaire is inadequate for the initial evaluation of the patient (with limited exceptions).
